name: Mineyama Sakiko
source:
Mama club member.

She is a housewife and has a son.

At first glance, she appears to be a foreigner, but she is a Japanese. She is popular at the club because of her cheerful personality and her well-built physique.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mmc3.html]official site[/url]]
